mentions.name: Eurotrucker smart-bike mod
mentions.description: A half-built 'Eurotrucker' mod that uses a smart exercise bike as the control interface for a truck-driving game, in the same spirit as bike-powered games. Development stalled on finding a steering input method that isn't incredibly awkward, since handlebar buttons could risk muscle-memory braking mistakes on a real bike.
mentions.problem: No workable steering input method was found; using handlebar buttons risks building muscle memory that could trigger the front brake on a real bike.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a half-built Eurotrucker mod somewhere for similar vibes. Never worked out a way of doing steering input that wasn’t incredibly awkward, though.

evidence.value: I have a half-built Eurotrucker mod somewhere for similar vibes. Never worked out a way of doing steering input that wasn’t incredibly awkward, though.
